hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(] *)git( +-[^ ]+( +[^ ]+)?)* +commit( |$)' || exit 0
b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$b" = main ] || [ "$b" = master ]; then
  jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Direct commits to main are blocked in this project. Create a branch first: git switch -c feature/<change-name>"}}'
fi
